 Judgment
This appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 31.01.2019 passed by the tribunal, in MVC.No.628/2015 seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
3.
The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.
4. In the present case, from the medical evidence on record it is proved that the claimant had suffered the following injuries.
i. Cut lacerated wound over right parieto occipital, right occipital region ii.
Swelling over left shoulder joint and left knee joint NC: 2023:KHC-D:13237
iii. X-ray of left shoulder shows the fracture of glenoid of scapula iv.
X-ray of left knee shows fracture of tibial spine 5.

The tribunal has awarded compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads.

Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Pain and suffering.
Medical expenses.

12,853/-
 3. Incidental expenditure 1,400/-
 4. Loss of future income 1,12,320/-
 Total: 1,51,573/-
Shri.Mohan S/O.Basanagouda Patil vs Smt.Aruna on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75755608/
3 6. Considering the nature of injuries sustained, compensation awarded by tribunal is lesser side.
Therefore, the same is required to be enhanced by modifying the judgment and award.

Considering the injuries sustained, a compensation of Rs.50,000/- towards pain and suffering,
Rs.35,000/- towards loss of amenities are awarded.
The compensation awarded towards medical expenses and hospital charges of Rs.12,853/- is as per the actual bills and receipts produced

;
therefore, the same is kept intact.

Further, Rs.5,000/- towards incidental expenses like food,
nourishment, traveling, attendant charges, etc., and Rs.24,000/- (Rs.12,000/- pm., x 2 months)
towards loss of income during laid up period for a period of four months, is awarded.
8. The doctor has stated that the claimant had suffered 30% of disability towards left upper limb and 20% of disability towards left lower limb.

Therefore, considering the evidence of the doctor, 15%
functional disability towards whole body is taken into consideration.
The accident is caused in the year 16.09.2014.
The claimant was doing commission agency business.
Therefore, notional income of Rs.12,000/- per month is taken into consideration, which is recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.
The claimant was aged 48 years at the time of accident.
Therefore, appropriate applicable multiplier is 13.

Hence, loss of future income due to disability is hereby reassessed and quantified as Rs.2,80,800/- (Rs.12,000/- x 15% x 12 x 13).
10.

Thus, the claimant is entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads. Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Towards injuries, pain and 50,000/-
 suffering.
 2. Towards medical expenses.

12,853/-
 3. Towards loss of amenities.

35,000/-
 4. Towards loss of income during 24,000/-
 laid up period and medical  NC: 2023:KHC-D:13237  treatment period.

4  5. Towards incidental charges like 5,000/-
attendant

charges, food,
nourishment, conveyance, etc.,

. 
6. Towards loss of future earning 2,80,800/-
capacity.
Total: 4,07,653/-
11.

Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.4,07,653/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till realization, as against Rs.1,51,573/-
awarded by the Tribunal.
The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

12. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 31.01.2019 passed by the tribunal, in MVC.No.628/2015 stands modified.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13237

iii ) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.4,07,653/-
along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.
iv) The claimant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 131 days in filing the appeal.
v) The insurance company shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
vi) No order as to costs.

vii) Draw award accordingly.
 SD/-
